previous_confirmed_p1: Universal combined body/footer cap and cited-parent numeric/contact checks fixed before source15; previous review preserves counterexamples and limits.
reviewed_guards: Only a substantive normative first candidate anchors expansion. Current permitted corpus membership and exact revision/extraction identity constrain SQL companions.

Published mode uses immutable PUBLISHED chunks from the same permitted current revision/extraction. Candidate preview uses its frozen changed-revision chunk ID membership, rather than unrestricted current chunks.
Canonical exact section heading and substantive noun/adjective query subject constrain companions. Added SQL recall candidates carry explicit score 0.0, without an invented vector or reranker score.

Section companions are added before unrelated pages; more than six required physical pages fails closed with SECTION_CONTEXT_TOO_COMPLEX. Existing full component count and combined body plus citation footer cap remain in force.
Context components and citation indices retain matching order; reviewed source text is not rewritten. Electronic mail compounds are masked only for subject recall, not in quoted evidence.
No specific source filename, physical page number, source UUID, or case answer is hardcoded in the new SQL expansion. Current citation reauthorization and transport presend gates remain unchanged.

agent_reported_tests_not_reexecuted_by_r.source: RAG agent report; full local verification separately records actual full suite

limits: Narrow read-only code review is not semantic acceptance, an independent penetration test, or proof for arbitrary unseen policies.
Actual current-image FULL source-case review, strict semantic review import, native validation/activation, HTTP100 and operational cold/fault proofs remain separate evidence.
Companion recall and query-subject detection are bounded heuristics. Source copying alone does not prove every required condition is complete for every future question.
